questions.question: Which manager led Charlton Athletic to back-to-back top-half Premier League finishes in 2003–04 and 2004–05 during his 15-year tenure at The Valley?
questions.explanation: Alan Curbishley established Charlton Athletic as a staple top-flight side, securing 7th and 11th-place finishes before stepping down in 2006.
questions.anchorClues: Alan Curbishley / Charlton Athletic Premier League

questions.question: True or False: Bradford City secured Premier League survival on the final day of the 1999–2000 season by defeating Liverpool 1–0 at Valley Parade.
questions.explanation: David Wetherall scored a famous early header to beat Liverpool 1–0, completing a miracle escape for Paul Jewell's side and relegating Wimbledon instead.
questions.anchorClues: Bradford City 1–0 Liverpool 2000 / Final day survival

questions.question: What was the final scoreline when Arsenal defeated Manchester United at Highbury in November 2001, remembered for Fabien Barthez gifting late goals to Sylvain Wiltord and Thierry Henry?
questions.explanation: Arsenal came from behind after Paul Scholes' opener to win 3–1, capitalising on two costly errors from United goalkeeper Fabien Barthez.

questions.question: Which iconic ground served as Southampton's home stadium for 103 years prior to their move to St Mary's Stadium in 2001?
questions.explanation: Southampton played at the compact 15,000-capacity Dell ground from 1898 until May 2001, closing its history with a 3–2 win over Arsenal.

questions.question: True or False: Oleksandr Zinchenko was the first Ukrainian player to win a Premier League winner's medal.
questions.explanation: Defender Oleg Luzhny was the first Ukrainian to win the Premier League title, doing so with Arsène Wenger's Arsenal during their 2001–02 double-winning campaign.
questions.anchorClues: First Ukrainian Premier League winner / Oleg Luzhny Arsenal

questions.question: Which striker scored the very first goal in Premier League history, finding the net after five minutes for Sheffield United against Manchester United in August 1992?
questions.explanation: Brian Deane wrote his name into top-flight history by heading past Peter Schmeichel at Bramall Lane in Sheffield United's 2–1 victory on 15 August 1992.
questions.anchorClues: Brian Deane / First Premier League goal August 1992

questions.question: Which squad number was worn by Matt Le Tissier throughout Southampton's entire Premier League era at The Dell, cementing his legendary status on the South Coast?
questions.explanation: Matt Le Tissier famously wore the number 7 shirt for Southampton, netting 100 Premier League goals for the Saints with his unmatched technical skill.
questions.anchorClues: Matt Le Tissier squad number 7 / Southampton

questions.question: Which club scored a staggering 106 goals during the 2017–18 campaign, setting the single-season record for the most goals scored by a team in Premier League history?
questions.explanation: Pep Guardiola's 'Centurions' scored 106 goals across 38 fixtures in 2017–18, surpassing Chelsea's previous record of 103 set in 2009–10.
questions.anchorClues: Manchester City 106 goals single season record 2017–18

questions.question: Which Bulgarian midfielder served as Aston Villa club captain and made over 180 Premier League appearances for the West Midlands club between 2006 and 2012?
questions.explanation: Stiliyan Petrov joined Aston Villa from Celtic in 2006 and became a beloved leader at Villa Park, captaining Martin O'Neill's side to top-six finishes.

questions.question: Which Danish football icon guided Swansea City to their first major trophy by winning the 2013 League Cup final 5–0, securing European football in their second PL season?
questions.explanation: Michael Laudrup managed Swansea City during a glittering 2012–13 campaign, playing stylish football and lifting the League Cup at Wembley against Bradford City.
questions.anchorClues: Michael Laudrup / Swansea City League Cup 2013
